note: Display metadata for item ids that are not blocks (drops, gear icons). Blocks keep their names in blocks.json; this file backfills everything else for the FQ-09 icon grids. color is the FQ-07 fallback swatch (hex, no #). Item-wiring flags: `ui_only: true` marks a recipe/gear icon surrogate that is NOT a real player item (cannot drop, be picked up, deposited, or crafted as an item); `future_use: true` marks a live-obtainable loot item that intentionally has no existing-system sink yet (kept obtainable and referentially valid, awaiting a future producer/consumer). See docs/ITEM_AND_RECIPE_MATRIX.md.

dirt.description: Soft ground. Quick to place, quick to mine.

bucket.description: Scoop a liquid (Place on lava/water), then pour it elsewhere (Place on an empty spot).

bucket_water.description: A bucket full of water. Place on an empty spot to pour it out.

bucket_lava.description: A bucket full of lava. Place on an empty spot to pour it out — mind the burn.

wood_platform.description: A thin plank you stand on and jump up through from below. Hold Down and press Jump to drop through it.

hellstone.description: Ember-veined rock from the deep hell layer. Needs a tier-2 pick.

obsidian.description: Glassy volcanic stone, forged where lava meets water. Needs a tier-2 pick.

ore.description: Raw ore. Needs a tier-2 pick.

tin_ore.description: A common metal ore; alloys with copper.

iron_ore.description: A deeper ore. Needs a tier-2 pick.

silver_ore.description: A deep, precious ore. Needs a tier-2 pick.

crystal.description: A deep, faceted crystal. Needs a tier-2 pick.

copper_ingot.description: Smelted at the furnace. Alloys into bronze.

tin_ingot.description: Smelted at the furnace. Alloys into bronze.

iron_ingot.description: Smelted at the furnace. Anvil stock for iron gear.

bronze_ingot.description: Alloyed from copper and tin at the furnace. Forged into bronze gear at the anvil.

crop_seeds.description: Plant on tilled soil (G) to grow food.

tree_seed.description: Plant on dirt or grass (Place) to grow a new tree. Dropped now and then when clearing leaves.

door.description: A wooden door. Place it in a wall; Place again on it to open or close it. Houses need at least one.

farm_soil.description: Tilled earth. Crops grow on it.

crop_seedling.description: A young crop. Give it time.

crop_ripe.description: Harvest (mine) for food and a seed.

meat.description: Thornrat meat. Cook it at the furnace for food.

thorn_quill.description: A barbed quill from a thornrat.

ore_flecks.description: Metal residue scraped from an ore tick. Reclaim it into ore at the furnace.

shell.description: The hard shell of an ore tick.

oil_rags.description: Oily rags from a torchbearer. Bundle with torch heads into torches.

torch_heads.description: Pitch-soaked torch heads. Bundle with oil rags and wood into torches.

chitin.description: A curved armor plate from a cave crawler.

silk.description: Pale fiber spun by cave crawlers.

eyes.description: A glossy alchemical reagent from a cave crawler.

coins.description: Worn coinage taken from raiders. Stockpile them for a raider-bounty contract.

picks.description: A bundle of raider digging picks.

fuse_cord.description: Oiled cord a sapper uses to breach walls.

scrap_weapons.description: Broken blades and bent points. Reclaim them into iron at the furnace.

tiny_core.description: A faintly humming mote. Set into a Focus Amulet at the workbench.
